description:
Our newly completed own-door apartments located in the heart of Ranelagh village, framed by tall trees and landscaped gardens, offer you a tranquil residence in one of the most popular Dublin locations.  With only a walk, bike or bus ride to town, Sandford Lodge offers a village setting with all the benefits of a city location. 
 
The morning sun fills each interior in our 1 and 2 bed homes, illuminating spacious and comfortable living spaces and bringing the beautiful design detail and finish of this boutique development to life. The landscaped gardens provide a sanctuary from bustling village life where you can relax in the peaceful surrounds of our manicured lawns and wild meadow gardens.
 
Our dedicated on-site property management team makes life easy at Sandford Lodge.  A professional and reliable service is on hand to tend to resident requests, manage private amenity bookings and more.
 
Private onsite amenities offer an optimum work-life balance.  Book a training session at the residents' gym or entertain your friends in the lounge. Join us for our regular community events to meet your neighbours and make new friends.  Herbert Park is only five minutes away on foot, opening your social life to outdoor yoga classes, food festivals and local events. Join a community of nature enthusiasts, health buffs and pleasure seekers who appreciate the outdoors and creative energy of Ranelagh's incredible eateries, bars and boutiques.
